## S2 CONFIG: the one place to set the System 2 model

Every System 2 workflow (system2 triage, S1 vs S2 comparison, chat escalation, five-questions CHOOSE) calls this workflow in a **Get S2 Model** node and uses the `model` it returns.

To use a different Ollama model, change the `model` value in **S2 Model Name** (run `ollama list` to see what is installed). Default: `gemma4:12b-mlx` (Apple Silicon). Elsewhere try `gemma4:12b`.

Import this workflow FIRST. If the callers cannot find it (their Get S2 Model node shows an error), open that node and pick **S2 Config** from the workflow list. Callers fall back to `gemma4:12b-mlx` if the call fails, so a failed lookup quietly ignores your override. Does not need to be activated.
